deadline.value: Apply by 15 December 2026 for Fall 2027; late applications may be considered but lose full fellowship consideration. Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: The deadline for Fall 2027 admission is December 15, 2026. | to receive full consideration, especially for Institute -and internal- fellowships, applications need to be submitted by the due dates

gre_general.value: For Fall 2027 the GRE General is optional.
gre_general.quote: For Fall 2027 applicants, the GRE tests (general and subject) are optional.

gre_subject.value: For Fall 2027 the Mathematics GRE Subject test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: For Fall 2027 applicants, the GRE tests (general and subject) are optional.

supervisor.value: The School of Math pages do not say whether you need a supervisor's agreement before applying.

toefl_min.value: Math sets a TOEFL iBT minimum of 96, though most admitted students score above 100 and speaking/listening get special attention; the Institute minimum of 90 also applies.
toefl_min.quote: We have a minimum TOEFL requirement for applicants whose native language is not English of 250 (computer-based), 600 (paper) or 96 (internet-based). | most admitted students have a TOEFL score above 100 (internet based)

funding.value: All math PhD students get a tuition waiver plus a TA or RA stipend (about USD 37,500 for 12 months in Fall 2025), normally for 5 years with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: All PhD students in the School of Math receive a tuition waiver as well as funding in the form of a Teaching Assistantship (or equivalent) or Research Assistantship, so prospective PhD students do not need to separately apply for funding from the School of Math. | For Fall 2025, the stipend for PhD students will be roughly $37,500 for 12 months.

also.quote: Doctoral students who are progressing satisfactorily in their course work and research and their TA duties, are supported as TAs for 5 years since entering the program.

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; a 4-year bachelor's in mathematics or a related subject with advanced math beyond calculus and linear algebra is required.
entry_route.quote: Is it necessary to have a master's degree for admission to the PhD programs? Is it necessary to get a master's degree on the way to the PhD? No.

also.quote: To be eligible to apply to any of the graduate programs in the School of Mathematics a student must receive a 4 year bachelor's degree or equivalent from a recognized institution of higher learning before enrolling.

notes: If an Institute-level fee waiver is denied, the School of Math might consider its own waiver. Math is also a home unit for the ACO, Machine Learning and Quantitative Biosciences PhDs.
